title: gastify: scan → cooked, with every number ghosted
card: A real domain line with a side input and a feedback loop — and not one measured number, because that project's data is not in this repo. Every count is a ghost rather than a plausible invention.
lede: Eight machines take a photographed receipt to a cooking event and back into a proficiency score. The shape is real. The numbers are not here — gastify lives in another repository — so every measured field renders as a named absence instead of a figure nobody could trace.
handle: A floor with no numbers cannot show a bottleneck, which is exactly what this page demonstrates: every machine looks equally important. That is the failure P1 predicts when the measured-number field is empty, shown rather than described.
source: STRUCTURE from the gastify domain; NUMBERS deliberately absent — this repository has no access to that project's data, and the carry-forward rule is that a number on a prism page comes from the actor table or it does not appear.
